findings.title: New BackupCode component is named `TwoFactor` in BackupCode.tsx
findings.description: The default export in the new `BackupCode.tsx` is declared as `export default function TwoFactor({ center = true })`, a copy-paste leftover from `TwoFactor.tsx`. Consumers import it under their own name (`import BackupCode from "@components/auth/BackupCode"` in `login.tsx` and `DisableTwoFactorModal.tsx`), so behavior is unaffected. Stack traces, React DevTools, and grep for the symbol will still show `TwoFactor` for the backup-code input. The function should be renamed to `BackupCode`.

findings.title: Lock icon import could not be checked in this session
findings.description: `apps/web/pages/auth/login.tsx` now imports `Lock` from `@calcom/ui/components/icon` for the "lost access" button. I could not open the icon module to confirm that `Lock` is exported, so this is unverified. If the export is missing, the login page will fail to build or render.
